dict.string: bitchat uses Bluetooth to discover nearby peers and exchange end-to-end encrypted messages over the mesh, without internet.
bitchat advertises over Bluetooth so nearby peers can find you and relay encrypted mesh messages.
bitchat uses the camera to scan QR codes when verifying peers.
bitchat uses your approximate location for optional local geohash channels. Your exact location is never shared.
bitchat uses the microphone to record push-to-talk voice messages for nearby peers.
bitchat lets you choose images and files from your library to share with nearby peers.
